Open-source licenses and third-party services

DevlogMaker is built on open-source software. Thank you to everyone who works on it.

The complete list of included components, with their license texts and copyright notices, is shipped with the App in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (in the installation folder). That file is the authoritative notice; this page summarises the main parts.

Main components included in the App

Component What it does in DevlogMaker License
FFmpeg Records, edits and renders the video (run as a separate program) LGPL 2.1 or later; the bundled build includes GPL components (for example x264), so it is distributed under the GPL version 3
Python Runs the bundled DevlogMaker engine Python Software Foundation License
Python libraries (including Pillow, Pygments, FastAPI, httpx, Pydantic, Typer, the Anthropic SDK, Google API client libraries) Cards, syntax highlighting, the local engine API, network requests Various permissive licenses (MIT, BSD, Apache 2.0, HPND); see the notices file
Tauri The desktop application shell MIT or Apache 2.0
React The user interface MIT
Saira typeface (website) Headings on this website SIL Open Font License 1.1

FFmpeg source code

FFmpeg is free software. Each release on the downloads page includes the complete FFmpeg source code of the bundled version (ffmpeg-<version>.tar.xz), next to the installer. The Windows build is the "essentials" build from gyan.dev, whose page lists the build configuration and included libraries. You are free to replace the bundled FFmpeg program with your own build. Questions: open an issue at github.com/glumbis/devlogmaker-app/issues.

Services the App connects to

These are online services, not software included in the App. They are provided by their owners under their own terms:

  • Claude by Anthropic, through your API key or Claude Desktop: writes the devlog script and publish text. Terms · Usage Policy · Privacy
  • ElevenLabs: text-to-speech narration. Terms · Prohibited Use Policy · Privacy
  • Gemini API by Google (optional): generates background music with Lyria. Terms · Google Privacy Policy
  • YouTube API Services by Google: video publishing. YouTube Terms of Service · Google Privacy Policy
  • Discord, Bluesky and Mastodon: posting announcements, under each service's own terms.

All trademarks belong to their respective owners. DevlogMaker is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, ElevenLabs, Google, YouTube, Discord, Bluesky, Mastodon, Godot or Unity.
